verdict.rationale: Unleash's pricing page lists audit logs as a product feature with up to 2 years of retention, so the product does provide an audit log for changes. However, that single line is the only evidence. Nothing documents that every flag change is recorded, or that entries capture the actor, timestamp, and before/after values. Missing for 10: documentation that all flag changes are logged, and that entries record who changed what, when, and to which value; audit log docs or API access to events; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value

citations.quote: Audit logs with up to 2 years retention
